entries.title: Test worker crashes in native compression library
entries.root_cause: The test runtime loads version 1.4.2 of the native tidepack library, whose JNI compression call crashes the JVM. Upgrade or replace that native library.

entries.title: Schema generation cannot read its input
entries.root_cause: The generateLedgerTypes task points to a schema file that is absent at the configured path. Restore the schema or correct the task input path.
